kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعتصب (form VIII)
# أَعْتَصِبُ (ʔaʕtaṣibu) /ʔaʕ.ta.sˤi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
# أَعْتَصِبَ (ʔaʕtaṣiba) /ʔaʕ.ta.sˤi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
# أَعْتَصِبْ (ʔaʕtaṣib) /ʔaʕ.ta.sˤib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِعْتَصَبَ (iʕtaṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
